meta.note: Cheap section: standing prices only (standing plan page + no end date + renewal terms stated or list price). 3 vendors live + 1 sold-out watch (Hetzner CX23, not on sale). renewalStatus values: stated-same-rate (official page states same-rate renewal) / list-price (list price, monthly cap) / unknown (not stated on the page). riskLevel: low / medium / high. plans arrays transcribe the vendor plan tables; annual totals are labelled conversions. offers.title: RackNerd VPS Specials: $21.99–$119.99/year (lifetime same-rate renewal)
offers.specText: KVM VPS, 1–7 vCPU, 1–8 GB RAM, 20–150 GB SSD, 3–20 TB transfer, 1 Gbps port, 1 IPv4, full root access, ctrl panel.
offers.durationText: Annual billing; official FAQ: lifetime same-rate renewal.
offers.cardNote: The plan page does not state payment method requirements — go by the checkout page.
offers.regions: Multiple locations (the page only says “deploy in multiple locations”; specific locations as shown at order time)
risks: The location list does not appear on the Specials page; available locations as shown at order time
Refund terms do not appear on the Specials page — go by the official terms
Unmanaged VPS; you manage it yourself
steps: Open the RackNerd official Specials page and confirm the current plans and prices.
Choose a plan and location; instant setup after ordering.
Manage via the ctrl panel or SSH; install one-click apps in ctrl if needed.
offers.notes: Plan ladder and lifetime same-rate renewal FAQ verified 2026-11-13 on the official Specials page; the catalog page (kvm-vps) has higher prices — Specials and catalog prices differ, see the detail page comparison.
offers.renewalText: Lifetime same-rate renewal (official FAQ wording: “lifetime recurring”, “renew at the same rate”)
offers.locations: Multiple locations (no specific cities listed on the page)

offers.title: HostEONS: from $21/year (renewal price not stated)
offers.specText: Two plan tables: Gigabit VPS (from $21/year, 1 fair-share core, 1 GB, 10 GB, 1 TB) and Ryzen Premium (from $24/year, 1 core 3.5GHz+ fair-share, 512 MB, 10 GB NVMe, 500 GB). 6 US locations, 1 IPv4, free IPv6.
offers.durationText: Annual billing (entry plans) and monthly billing (other tiers); renewal price not stated on the page.
offers.cardNote: The plan pages do not state payment method requirements; payment icons shown on the page include Alipay, UnionPay, PayPal, Bitcoin, credit cards, and wire transfer.
offers.regions: Los Angeles, Salt Lake City, Portland, New York, Miami, Dallas (plan table wording); the footer also lists 8 data centers including Frankfurt (Dallas appears twice) — Frankfurt does not appear in the plan tables and is unverified
risks: Renewal price does not appear on either plan page — do not assume renewal at the first-year price; confirm on the checkout page before buying
CPU is fair share, not dedicated
The footer Frankfurt location claim is inconsistent with the plan tables (6 US cities in the tables) and is unverified
steps: Open the HostEONS official plan pages and confirm the current plans and prices.
Confirm the renewal price and billing period on the checkout page before ordering.
Manage via the VPS control panel (reboot, reinstall, VNC, custom ISO).
offers.sourceName: HostEONS KVM VPS page and Ryzen Premium page
offers.notes: Both plan tables verified 2026-11-13 on the official pages; neither page states a renewal price, so this site does not assume same-rate renewal. Payment methods per the icons shown on the page.
offers.validityText: Standing prices, no end date; renewal price not stated
offers.renewalText: Renewal price not stated on the page — go by the checkout page
offers.locations: Los Angeles, Salt Lake City, Portland, New York, Miami, Dallas

offers.title: DigitalOcean Basic Droplets: from $4/month (monthly cap)
offers.specText: Basic Droplets (shared CPU): 512 MiB $4.00/month (1 vCPU, 10 GiB, 500 GiB); 1 GiB $6.00/month (1 vCPU, 25 GiB, 1,000 GiB). Per-second billing (from January 1, 2026), monthly cap.
offers.durationText: Monthly-capped list prices, no end date; pay for what you use, never above the monthly cap.
offers.cardNote: The pricing page does not state payment method requirements — go by the official page.
offers.regions: Data center regions do not appear on the pricing page — go by the console
risks: Basic is shared CPU, suited to bursty loads, not workloads needing sustained dedicated CPU
Backups and snapshots cost extra: backups 20% of Droplet cost (weekly) / 30% (daily), snapshots $0.06/GB/month
Data center regions do not appear on the pricing page
steps: Open the DigitalOcean official Droplet pricing page and confirm the current prices.
In the console, choose a Basic plan, region, and OS to create a Droplet.
Enable backups as needed; note backups and snapshots cost extra.
offers.notes: Basic plan table, per-second billing, and monthly-cap rules verified 2026-11-13 on the official pricing page; 12-month conversions ($48/year, $72/year) are this site’s calculations from the monthly cap prices, labelled as such.
offers.validityText: Standing list prices, no end date
offers.renewalText: Monthly cap price (list price), no intro discount; monthly bill never exceeds the cap
offers.locations: Not stated on the pricing page
